question: Which of the following dance forms is performed to Carnatic music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kuchipudi** is known as the **eight major Indian classical dances.**
 
• It originates from a** village named Kuchipudi** in the** Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• **Kuchipudi** is a dance-drama performance, with its roots in the ancient** Hindu Sanskrit text of Natya Shastra.​​​**
 
• **Tirtha Narayanayati**, a composer of Carnatic music and his orphan disciple **Sidhyendra Yogi**, a Telugu Brahmin, are accredited for initiating, methodizing and arranging the present day version of Kuchipudi in the 17th century.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Kathak** is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance. It is the classical dance form from **Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• **Odissi,** also referred to as Orissi in old literature, is a major ancient Indian classical dance that originated in **the temples of Odisha **– an eastern coastal state of India. 
 
• **Sattriya** dance originated in **Assam**.
